We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: A deputy director of environmental protection bureau, in charge of supervision, signed off that project was completed and passed inspection, despite not completed, leading to improper payment of special funds (240 million? Actually 240万元 and 116.21万元). This is abuse of power for personal gain? He signed false documents to get funds to the operating unit. This is likely "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and possibly "受贿" if he received bribes? Not mentioned receiving money. He caused improper allocation of funds, maybe "挪用公款"? He didn't take money himself. He caused the unit to receive funds. Could be "徇私舞弊" (but not in list). There's "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" but that's about not handing over. There's "滥用职权" (abuse of power). Also "受贿" is taking bribes; not indicated. Could be "贪污" (embezzlement) if he appropriated public funds. But he didn't appropriate; he facilitated payment to a company. Could be "职务侵占" (occupying public funds) but not in list. There's "受贿" and "滥用职权". The description: He signed false documents, causing misappropriation of funds. That is typical of "滥用职权" (abuse of power) under Chinese criminal law article 397. Also could be "贪污" if he personally benefited. Not indicated. So likely "滥用职权". Also maybe "挪用公款" if he misused funds, but again he didn't take them. So answer: 滥用职权.

Check list: "滥用职权" is present. So single label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]滥用职权<eoa>
